code:
# Inside one server:
#   NVLink + NVSwitch  -> hundreds of GB/s to ~1TB/s per GPU
#   (bypasses PCIe ~64GB/s and the CPU entirely)
#
# Between servers:
#   InfiniBand + GPUDirect RDMA
#   -> GPU writes directly into a REMOTE GPU's memory,
#      skipping both CPUs and main memory
caption: Tensor parallelism stays inside the NVLink box; pipeline parallelism stretches across InfiniBand.

#   per-GPU compute share shrinks
#   AllReduce still moves every gradient, every step
#
# Past a certain scale: sync time > compute time

#

caption: At scale, distributed training is a networking problem as much as a compute problem.
